data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 直播开场前的招呼练习
data.description: 纱雾穿薄荷绿抓绒连帽衫和藏蓝家居长裤，坐在绘图桌前朝小摄像头练习挥手。小熊玩偶稳稳坐在键盘旁，她看见自己招呼得太认真，忍不住低头笑了；画板与台灯一起组成明亮的工作角落。
data.action: 朝桌上摄像头练习挥手，被自己的认真模样逗笑。
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi practices waving toward the small desk camera, then lowers her head with a laugh at her own earnest greeting. Her fully zipped mint fleece hoodie has small bear ears above navy lounge trousers. A bear plush sits securely beside the keyboard, tablet nearby. The medium view holds the bright working corner together; soft frontal desk light illuminates her raised hand and plush face, casting compact shadows beneath the keyboard and toy.
